peptide_bioactivity.verification: Full text (Elsevier PDF, institutional subscription, read 2026-10-01): mackerel (S. japonicus, Hui'an Ruifang Food, Quanzhou) muscle hydrolysate; 285 peptides identified by LC-MS/MS (Table S1), pentapeptides ranked by a 5z-scale QSAR model and in silico filters (Section 3.3). LTPFT, PLITT and PVVDT synthesized by Fmoc solid phase (Sangon, >98%, LC-MS confirmed; Section 2.9). PLITT IC50 48.73 +- 7.59 uM by DoseResp fit (Section 3.4, Fig. 3B, abstract); LTPFT and PVVDT have no IC50. HHL 2.5 mM, ACE (Sigma) 0.1 U/mL, borate pH 8.3 with 0.3 M NaCl, 37 C 60 min, hippuric acid by HPLC at 228 nm (Section 2.8). Not recorded: CRLTT 4.06 uM is a QSAR prediction, never synthesized or measured.

Full text (Wiley PDF, institutional subscription, read 2026-10-01): mackerel (S. japonicus, Hui'an Ruifang Food, Fujian) papain hydrolysate, <3 kDa (MMPH-1), Sephadex G-15 fraction MMPH-1A; 285 peptides identified by nano-LC-MS/MS (Q Exactive, -10lgP > 20; Section 3.2, Table S1), ten chosen by PeptideRanker, PepSite2 and ToxinPred and synthesized (Sangon, >98%; Section 2.5). APFLAG IC50 69.45 +- 2.93 uM (Section 3.2, Fig. 2B, Table 2, abstract). HHL 2.5 mM, ACE (Sigma A6778) 0.1 U/mL, borate pH 8.3 with 0.3 M NaCl, 37 C 60 min, hippuric acid by HPLC at 228 nm (Section 2.3). Same group and peptide list as Wang 2024 (Food Chem 447:138873), but different sequences, so neither replicates the other.
